news.title: v0.9.2 - Steam Next Fest Patch
news.shortDescription: Performance improvements, new checkpoints, and balloon physics tweaks.
news.fullBody:
We have pushed a new patch ahead of Steam Next Fest!

What's new:
- Optimized draw calls on the flooded city theme
- Added 3 new mid-level checkpoints
- Balloon force coordination now scales smoothly with 3-4 players
- Fixed a rare desync on the train event

Thanks for all the feedback, keep it coming!

news.title: Steam Next Fest is Live!
news.shortDescription: Play the demo for free during Steam Next Fest. Leave us a review!
news.fullBody:
Guinea Pig Runaway is now playable during Steam Next Fest!

Download the free demo, grab a friend, and see how far you can roll.

If you enjoy it, wishlist the game and drop a review — it helps us a lot.
